Several root folders, each under a divider; buckets for the root folder; italic names for unread files.

**Root folders.**
- The panel can show more than one folder. **Add root folder…**, in a root folder's menu or the options, picks a folder of the workspace; one that is already shown, lies inside one or holds one is refused, so no file is listed twice. The list is kept in `docsPanel.folder`, which now also takes a list: `["docs", "notes"]`.
- With several, each root folder stands under a divider labelled with its name. Its menu, on the divider or the empty space under the folder, has **Tag buckets…**, **New file…**, **New folder…**, **Reveal in file explorer**, **Copy path**, **Add root folder…** and **Remove root**, which only stops showing it.
- New options, in a **Root folders** section: what the divider says (name, path or nothing), where (left, centre, right), its text size, capitals and weight, its colour, the line (solid, dashed, dotted, double, none) and its thickness, and the room above it.
- Each root folder has its own `.docs-panel.json` and trash. Tags are shared across them: a tag given to a file in another root folder keeps its colour, letters and style, and a change to a tag is made in every folder's file. Files and folders can be dragged from one root folder to another and take their tags and colour along.
- Every path is now from the workspace root (`docs/plans/roadmap.md`). The settings and read marks files written by earlier versions are found and rewritten once, their paths put behind the first root folder's, so nothing set or read is lost. A single root folder keeps the plain string setting it always had.

**Tag buckets.**
- The root folder can have buckets: **Tag buckets…** in its menu, on the empty space under the tree when there is one root folder.
- The bucket picker opens to the right of the side, so the buckets can be watched as tags are picked.
- A new option sets the size of the buckets' headings, 50% to 250% of the tree's text.

**Tree.**
- The dot before a file is gone. A file not read yet has its name in italics; a pinned file's pin stands where the dot was. In a tag bucket the empty slot is gone too, so file names start at the bucket's edge, and a pin goes after the name.
- In a file's or folder's colour menu, picking the colour it already has takes it off.

**Links.**
- A Markdown link to a workspace file outside the root folders opens it in an editor, where before it did nothing.

Install: download `docs-panel-0.14.0.vsix` below, then run `code --install-extension docs-panel-0.14.0.vsix`.
